c. 1949
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed notes by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
"KNOW THE TRUTH AND THE TRUTH WILL MAKE YOU FREE"
But what is TRUTH, that we may get a knowl'eg of it at whatever cost? Webster defines truth: "The being true," etc. His defini- tions are rather weak and incomplete. The words of Saint John the Apostle and Evangelist in reference to charity and which can be per- fectly applied to Truth would be decidedly better and would read: "God is truth and he who remaineth in truth remaineth in God and God in him." This harmonizes perfectly with Jesus" own words in another place in the same Gosple: "I am the way, The Truth and the life."
Hence, the importence of education - of finding-out about the truth and what-pertains to truth, In other words what ever pertains to God. Hence again, though we do well to study the so-called
"sciences" as leading to Truth - of God Himself; in most of our mod- ern educational systems the supremely outstanding and only really necessary science of all sciences - Religion, the science of our hap- py relationship and dependence on God and our neighbor is daily more and more being excluded and debared from our school-rooms, from our colleges, from our universities. .... ,
Hence the sad want of knowledge of the divine Truth, the lament- able ignorance about God and supernatural things, the threatening spread of atheism - climax in itself of intellectual insanity and the appallingly scandalous decision made in its favor only last year, that if permitted to stand will go down in history as a blot on the records of one of our fairest ....
And yet: if men would only stop to think, and to learn the lesson from history - always repeated - and from history's eternal God, never changing that lesson - that outstanding admonition to all and every rational creature - that we get nowhere without Him. (Except to Hell). If nations and governments, and all Israel, if humanity - Adam's pos- terity - would only listen to reason and faith as well as to common sense - all stressing together that same admonition: 0, what a differ- ent outlook society would at once put on! What faith! What hope! What charity would be man's life here on God's footstool! - here - the privileged vestibule to a happy eternity for appreciative, grateful souls.
